title: Model-Agnostic Open-Set Air-to-Air Visual Object Detection for Reliable UAV Perception
abstract: arXiv:2509.09297v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Open-set detection is crucial for robust UAV autonomy in air-to-air object detection under real-world conditions. Traditional closed-set detectors degrade significantly under domain shifts and flight data corruption, posing risks to safety-critical applications. We propose a novel, model-agnostic open-set detection framework designed specifically for embedding-based detectors. The method explicitly handles unknown object rejection while maintaining robustness against corrupted flight data. It estimates semantic uncertainty via entropy modeling in the embedding space and incorporates spectral normalization and temperature scaling to enhance open-set discrimination. We validate our approach on the challenging AOT aerial benchmark and through extensive real-world flight tests. Comprehensive ablation studies demonstrate consistent improvements over baseline methods, achieving up to a 10\% relative AUROC gain compared to standard YO

translated_title: 模型无关的开放集空对空视觉目标检测，用于可靠的无人机感知
translated_abstract: 摘要：开放集检测对于无人机在真实条件下进行空对空目标检测时实现鲁棒自主性至关重要。传统的封闭集检测器在域偏移和飞行数据损坏下性能显著下降，对安全关键应用构成风险。我们提出了一种新颖的、模型无关的开放集检测框架，专门针对基于嵌入的检测器设计。该方法明确处理未知物体拒绝，同时保持对损坏飞行数据的鲁棒性。它通过嵌入空间中的熵建模估计语义不确定性，并结合谱归一化和温度缩放来增强开放集判别能力。我们在具有挑战性的AOT空中基准上以及通过广泛的实飞测试验证了我们的方法。全面的消融研究表明，与基线方法相比，我们的方法持续改进，相对于标准YO在AUROC上实现了高达10%的相对提升。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种模型无关的开放集检测框架，通过熵建模、谱归一化和温度缩放增强基于嵌入的检测器，在空对空无人机目标检测中实现了对未知物体的有效拒绝和损坏数据的鲁棒性，并在AOT基准和实飞测试中取得了显著性能提升。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a model-agnostic open-set detection framework that enhances embedding-based detectors via entropy modeling, spectral normalization, and temperature scaling, enabling effective unknown rejection and robustness against corrupted data in air-to-air UAV detection, with significant performance gains on the AOT benchmark and real flights.
